justification: The explicit 13-vertex circulant differs from the 12-vertex Chvátal reference. It is 4-regular, and no three allowed edge differences sum to 0 modulo 13, so it is triangle-free. The stated gap argument is correct: either possible gap partition for five independent vertices forces consecutive gaps 2 and 3, producing an edge. Thus its independence number is at most 4, and three colors cannot cover its 13 vertices.
